name: phi-delegate
description: Always-on PHI guardrail for Claude Code plus a covered BAA/ZDR delegate lane

guardrail.title: Guardrail
guardrail.description: auto: on, except for a skill-only install.sh setup (a phi-delegate symlink in the skills folder), where it stays off until you choose on. The PHI_DELEGATE_GUARDRAIL=on|off environment variable overrides this.

prompt_keyword_classes.title: Scan prompts and tool output for keyword classes
prompt_keyword_classes.description: Also flag dob-keyword, identifier-keyword, patient-name-keyword, and clinical-keyword. Off by default because schema talk trips them.

allowlist_file.title: Allowlist file
allowlist_file.description: Optional path to a file of extended regexes, one per line, applied to matched lines (for example your company email domain). Empty for none.

allowlist.title: Allowlist
allowlist.description: Extended regexes, one per entry, added to the allowlist file's (for example your company email domain). A matched line that also matches an entry is not counted.

phi_sources.title: PHI source command patterns
phi_sources.description: JavaScript regexes matched against Bash commands. A match is denied with an instruction to delegate. A repo can add more in a .phi-sources file at its root.

scrub_tool_output.title: Scrub tool output
scrub_tool_output.description: Replace flagged tool results with a counts-only notice, for the tools scrub_scope names.

scrub_scope.title: Scrub scope
scrub_scope.description: data: scrub only output that can carry records (Bash commands in scrub_commands or phi_sources, Read of files in scrub_files, tools in scrub_tools, background command output). all: every Bash, Read, Grep, and MCP result.

scrub_commands.title: Data commands
scrub_commands.description: JavaScript regexes for Bash commands whose output is scrubbed under the data scope.

scrub_tools.title: Data tools
scrub_tools.description: JavaScript regexes for tool names (MCP tools included) whose output is scrubbed under the data scope.

scrub_files.title: Data files
scrub_files.description: JavaScript regexes (case-insensitive) for file paths whose Read output is scrubbed under the data scope.
